flags.sentence: Upon payment in full, Developer assigns to Client all rights in the App's source code and designs that Developer creates for Client under this Agreement.
flags.overreach: It covers only the App's code and designs made for Client and paid for under this Agreement.
flags.description: This clause gives Client the App's code and designs once it has paid you in full. Your own libraries and tools stay yours under the next sentence.
flags.counterOffer: No change needed: the assignment is limited to the paid App.

notFlagged: Either party may end this Agreement for any reason on 14 days' written notice by email.
Developer is free to build apps for other clients, including other gyms and fitness studios, during and after this Agreement.
Each party's total liability under this Agreement is limited to the fee paid or payable under it.
Any dispute arising under this Agreement will be decided by the courts of the county where Developer lives.
Developer keeps all rights in the code libraries, frameworks and tools that Developer owned before the start date, and grants Client a permanent, non-exclusive license to use them as part of the App.
notes: Identical to ip-overreaching.txt except Sections 4.1 and 4.2. The assignment covers only the paid App and Developer keeps pre-existing tools, so it stays inside the deal. Every other sensitive clause is scoped to the job, so a correct analysis returns no flags.
